name: I/35 Turnov → Valdštejnsko

official.note: The OSM highway=proposed line of the I/35 Turnov – Úlibice (proposed=trunk, ref 35; the E1 line of the 2021 EIA opinion, 33.0 km as the 2023 ŘSD technical study), from the D10/I/35 at Ohrazenice through the Pelešany tunnel to where the D35 Úlibice bypass starts (research/89).

A.note: Ohrazenice: 600 m along the mapped I/35 line, past the D10 / I/35 interchange west of Turnov (its OSM ramps reach km 0.28; the interchange is rebuilt by its own stage, MÚK Ohrazenice) and the Liberec–Turnov railway the line crosses at km 0.39, so that our end stands on neither

B.note: Valdštejnsko: 6.4 km along the mapped line, 0.7 km past the Valdštejnsko interchange (OSM ramps at km 5.5–5.7): past the railway and road I/35 the line bridges at km 5.48 / 5.51 and road III/2835 at km 6.13, so the section ends on open ground; the next stage, Valdštejnsko – Čímyšl, starts here

baselineNote: Planned, not built (ŘSD: new EIA from 2026, works from about 2032; research/89). The planned line is OSM highway=proposed, outside the road network. Ground depths are uncalibrated regional priors.
